attributes.action: BRING BACK FACESITTING! Amend the Crime and Policing Act 2026
attributes.additional_details: The government introduced Crime and Policing Act 2026. For some reason the act encompasses moves and traditional techniques used across pro wrestling and adult entertainment that have no history of harm being caused to anyone, and are performed privately and publicly (ref: WWE wrestling) by consenting adults. Ban dangerous acts, yes, but this is over-censorship and unfair. The fetish industry pays millions in tax per year to the government, and they use this to penalize and de-platform creators
attributes.background: The government must review and amend the recent Crime and Policing Act 2026. The Act is unfair and disproportionate, making traditional, safe, and controlled pro wrestling and adult entertainment practices now illegal. You are 28,000 times more likely to die by lightning strike than by facesitting

rejection.details:
We already have a petition open on this subject which you may wish to sign:
